name: @w6w-apps/goto-webinar
description: Schedule and manage GoTo Webinar webinars, registrants, panelists and attendance, and start workflows on registrations, joins, webinar changes and surveys.

w6w.longDescription:
GoTo Webinar runs the webinar itself — scheduling sessions, accepting registrations, inviting panelists and reporting who actually showed up — and this app brings that lifecycle into a workflow.

Create single-session or multi-session (series) webinars, update or cancel them, and register attendees directly rather than routing them through a separate signup form. Panelists can be invited by email, and once a session has run, registrant, session and attendance data can be read back to drive follow-up automation — a CRM sync for no-shows, a follow-up email for attendees, or a report merging registration against actual join time.

A common pattern is triggering a workflow off an external event — a course enrollment, a CRM stage change, a landing-page form — and registering the person for the right webinar session directly, or reading attendance back afterward to decide who gets which follow-up.

This app covers the everyday webinar/registrant/panelist/attendance lifecycle over GoTo's own OAuth 2.0 provider; it does not cover webhooks, user subscriptions, co-organizers, audio settings or recording assets, which are documented but left for a follow-up pass.

Triggers start a workflow when someone registers for a webinar, a registrant joins a session, a webinar is created or changed, or an attendee submits a survey (or on any of GoTo's five events), and a poll starts one when a webinar gains a completed session or a panelist. Subscribing runs GoTo's webhook setup (create, activate, subscribe the connected user) for the trigger's URL and unsubscribing removes it; every delivery is verified with the webhook secret key and a five-minute timestamp window.
